question: D1's PR can't open: 4 reviewer usage rows were recorded with a capitalised persona ("Nobunaga"), and pr_delivery normalize refuses them. How should it unblock?

options.label: Normalize reads case ⭐ (Recommended)
options.consequence: D1 makes Hatsu's pr_delivery normalize accept a known persona in any case and render it lowercase, with a fixture. The ledger is never touched; it is folded under #542. A nen issue is filed for write-time validation.

options.label: One-time ledger repair
options.consequence: A scripted fix rewrites the 4 rows to lowercase, recorded as a Decisions row on the PR as an exception to #542's rule that generated ledgers are never hand-edited.

options.label: Hold for nen verb
options.consequence: File the nen issue (supersede verb plus write-time validation); D1's PR waits until nen ships and Hatsu repins.
